source: The game tells the story of a young couple who recently got married and started living together. It would seem that nothing should interfere with family happiness, but life circumstances and surrounding people will gradually push the wife of the main character to the idea of non-standard relationships in marriage, where she tries on the role of a dominant, the role of a Mistress ...
translation: 该游戏讲述了一对刚刚结婚并开始同居的年轻夫妇的故事。看似家庭幸福是不应该有任何事情干扰的，但生活环境和周围的人却会逐渐将主角的妻子推向非标准的婚姻关系，尝试扮演霸主、小三的角色……
